R1-R4 each recorded as pass or fail with a link to the review, statuses or workflow run.
GO or NO-GO recorded here, and the minimise outcome recorded on theseus-review-minimize-superseded-20261110.
context:
#61 was held until after the v0.2.11 tag (owner decision 2026-11-11); this item gives it a purpose in the rollout.

Gate clarifications (TODO review 2026-11-12): R4 not exercised (no superseded verdict review on #61) = GO on R1-R3, and the first BenchBox PR becomes the first App-token observation. A non-SHIP hosted verdict on #61 follows the escalation rule: findings are fixed only within the rule (at most 3 rounds, High/Critical or DO NOT SHIP escalates to the owner); a review-format defect visible in R1-R3 is NO-GO, not a fix loop. If the token is refused, set minimize_superseded false in Theseus's own policy as well as leaving it off in BenchBox.
description:
Owner decision 2026-11-12: the Theseus self-lock to v0.2.11 (with minimize_superseded: true) merges before the BenchBox v0.2.11 lock is armed, and dependabot #61 (ruff 0.17.3 -> 0.17.4) is the first PR reviewed under v0.2.11. Its result is the go/no-go for arming BenchBox.
Steps: after the self-lock merges, merge origin/main into #61 (strict up-to-date rule; this creates a new head, so the earlier v0.2.4 review on #61 becomes superseded). Wait for the hosted review and gate. If #61 has no superseded verdict review to minimise, record that minimising was not exercised and leave the observation to the first BenchBox PR.
Verification rubric (all recorded with links):
R1 Body: line 1 is `### <mark> <DECISION> · <fact>`; reviewed SHA shown once; reviewer notes and run details collapsed; `<!-- review-verdict: v2 <state> <40hex> -->` and the review-protocol record each appear exactly once, with the record as the last bytes.
R2 Statuses: review-verdict and review-gate descriptions are <= 140 chars; review-gate posted pending while waiting and passed on SHIP.
R3 Threads (only if findings): first line `<mark> **<Severity>** · D<n> · <title>`, dispute footer present, markers unchanged.
R4 Minimise: the superseded earlier verdict review is collapsed as outdated, OR the minimise call failed and verdict, statuses and gate are unaffected (workflow log line recorded). Webhook side effects: no extra verdict or gate run was triggered by the minimise (run list recorded).
Decision gate: GO = R1-R3 pass and R4 either minimised or failed harmlessly. NO-GO on any R1-R3 failure: do not arm BenchBox; revert the Theseus self-lock if the gate is broken, and report to the owner. If R4 failed harmlessly, BenchBox ships with minimize_superseded off (owner decision 2026-11-12) and the failure is recorded on theseus-review-minimize-superseded-20261110.
Guardrails: Theseus merge rule G7 for #61 (hosted SHIP on the current head + green checks + independent review of the exact final head); at most one /review per head; no owner-only actions; no live model calls beyond the hosted review the PR triggers.
